properties.notes: The site has been allocated in the DMP (DMP site allocation policy RTC4) for mixed-use housing (potentially housing for older people) and community use. The site is situated in a highly accessible location, in close proximity to Redhill town centre and adjacent to the rail station. The site provides an opportunity for intensification of an existing previously developed site. The site is partially affected by Flood Zones 2 and 3a and there are a number of protected trees on the site.
